First pre-release of 1.4 — the Preview becomes the **KOReader workbench**. Linux and macOS only (as before).

## New

- **KOReader in the background.** The Preview area starts the desktop KOReader invisibly (no window) at the full resolution of your device and shows the page as a picture in the area. Starting takes about a second, every further page a tenth of a second.
- **Two views:** *Reading page* (an opened book) and *Start screen* (KOReader without a book — the file browser or Bookshelf, with eight sample books and covers).
- **Turn pages** with ◀ ▶, by clicking into the picture (left third back, otherwise forward, as on the e-reader) or with the arrow keys.
- **Book selection** instead of the book list: a sample text with title, author and series (enough for Bookends), a book of the opened library with its book data (.sdr, so font size and margins match the e-reader) or any other file. From the library: right-click a book > *Open in Preview*.

## Changed

- The workbench runs on a throw-away copy of the preview profile, recreated at every start — reading positions, history and settings of the profile stay untouched. Only the plugins Bookends and Bookshelf are loaded; other plugins can cover the screen.
- *Start* is now **Open in KOReader** and opens the full KOReader in a window, as before (for trying out menus).
- Profile, device and output are folded away under *Profile, device and output*.
- KOReader in the background stops when Bookbench closes, and by itself 30 seconds after a crash.

## Known gaps

- Turning pages on the Bookshelf start screen is untested and may not work yet.
- Plugin pages (Bookends, Bookshelf), margins and fonts, patches and the way back to the e-reader follow in the next betas.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.4-beta1.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*). The Preview area does not exist on Windows.
